settings.title: Tell us about your brand
settings.text: A 15-minute discovery call. Your products, your audience, and which gifts you want paired with wine, champagne, or spirits.

settings.title: We build your page
settings.text: A co-branded product page in your look and feel — your logo, your colors — “powered by Go-To Gifting,” live on our licensed store.

settings.title: We capture the sale & comply
settings.text: Checkout runs through Go-To Gifting as the licensed seller of record. Age verification, adult-signature delivery, and state eligibility are handled automatically.

settings.title: You earn on every order
settings.text: Orders are tagged to your brand, picked and packed at our alcohol-ready warehouse, and shipped to 42+ states. You collect an affiliate commission — no licenses, no logistics.

settings.title: Sell what you legally can’t
settings.text: Wine, champagne, and spirits pairings for your products — sold under our license, not yours. The gap between “wine not included” and “wine included” becomes your upside.

settings.title: Your brand stays front and center
settings.text: Customers see your name, your logo, your aesthetic. The “powered by” line keeps it honest; everything else looks and feels like you.

settings.title: Compliance built in
settings.text: 21+ age gates, ID and adult-signature delivery, destination-state rules — enforced at the right layer, reviewed against our licensing. You never touch it.

settings.title: Real fulfillment muscle
settings.text: Backed by our alcohol-ready 3PL in Ventura, CA — the same operation behind The BroBasket (since 2014) and The Bounty Basket Co. Learn more at thebevconnect.com.

settings.title: Clean commission reporting
settings.text: Every order line is tagged to your brand, so payouts are transparent and reconcilable — no guesswork.

settings.title: Live in weeks, not quarters
settings.text: No store to build, no licenses to chase. Send us your brand assets and products; we handle the rest.

settings.heading: Become powered by Go-To Gifting
settings.subheading: Your brand, our license. Sell wine and spirits gifts without holding a single permit — we capture the sale as the licensed seller of record, fulfill compliantly, and pay you a commission on every order.
settings.steps_heading: From “we can’t sell alcohol” to live in weeks
settings.final_text: Tell us about your brand and your products, and we’ll map the right path on a 15-minute call.
settings.fineprint: Go-To Gifting LLC is the seller of record on all orders. Partner brands act as marketing affiliates and are not parties to the sale. Alcohol available only in eligible states; 21+ with ID and adult signature required at delivery.
